title: Zephyr Reef Grand Prix
summary: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash leads, with GPT-6 Astra subagents.
description: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash leads, with GPT-6 Astra subagents. A browser kart racer made from the same game brief as the other 3 entries in this comparison. Each build started from scratch. Astra used medium reasoning and DeepSeek used max reasoning throughout.
